text_block_list.text:
While everyone ponders the true meaning of 
the Grand Live, fans who have watched 
their journey step forward, offering to 
help out.

Listening to the fans, Light Hello gets a 
flash of inspiration. She proposes letting 
the fans shout freely during concerts and 
asks the performers to listen closely to 
their voices.

On stage, the members were showered with 
overflowing "feelings"—the fans, too, had 
feelings they wanted to convey to them.

Having witnessed that scene, Light Hello 
became convinced that the Grand Live was 
essential for the fans, and resolved to 
rebuild it.
